# Sample timelines

Timelines other editors wrote, from OpenTimelineIO's test files, under its Apache-2.0 licence ([LICENSE.otio.txt](LICENSE.otio.txt)). They are test data, and no build ships them.

| File                                                                                      | From                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `premiere_example.xml`                                                                    | Premiere Pro's own FCP7 XML: [otio-fcp-adapter](https://github.com/OpenTimelineIO/otio-fcp-adapter) `tests/sample_data` |
| `hiero_xml_export.xml`                                                                    | Hiero's FCP7 XML: the same folder                                                                                       |
| `premiere_example.otio`, `transition_test.otio`, `nested_example.otio`, `multitrack.otio` | [OpenTimelineIO](https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/OpenTimelineIO) `tests/sample_data`                       |

None came from DaVinci Resolve: no open test set holds one. Opening what we export in Resolve, and importing what it exports, is left to the user.
